items.q: What makes NeoCare different from other diapers?
items.a: NeoCare is made in Bangladesh by Incepta Hygiene & Hospicare Ltd. Every diaper is built from five parts: a super absorbent polymer core, hydrophobic leg cuffs, an elastic back ear, a refastenable hook-and-loop tab, and a breathable textile back sheet. The New Born size adds a curved waistband that leaves the healing navel untouched.

items.q: Is NeoCare safe for newborn skin?
items.a: NeoCare is made for babies from birth. The layer against the skin is soft and cloth-like, the outer sheet is breathable, and the New Born size has a curved waistband so nothing presses on the healing navel. Change a diaper as soon as it is wet or soiled, and speak to your doctor if you notice any irritation.

items.q: What is the umbilical cord cutout, and which size has it?
items.a: It is a gentle curve at the waistband that leaves the healing navel untouched. It is on the New Born size only.
NeoCare is made by Incepta Hygiene & Hospicare Ltd. in Bangladesh.

items.q: Where can I buy NeoCare offline?
How should I dispose of used diapers?
items.a: Roll the used diaper inward, close it with the side tabs, and put it in a covered household bin. Please do not flush it — a diaper will block a toilet or drain.
